title: Figure 14: Object Sightings by Month Among the Eight Duration Groups, All Years
description: Stacked percentage bar chart with one bar per month from January to December, divided into eight duration groups from "5 sec and less" to "Over 30 min" and "Not stated". The y-axis is "Per Cent of Each Months Object Sightings", and monthly sighting totals are printed above the bars (e.g., 638 in July). Dashed lines connect group boundaries between months. Caption: "FIGURE 14 DISTRIBUTION OF OBJECT SIGHTINGS BY MONTHS AMONG THE EIGHT DURATION GROUPS FOR ALL YEARS"; drawing A-7492.
